reviews.x: Bought these as part of a birthday present for my Mom who loves footcare products. She absolutely loves these and won’t stop using them so an easy 5 stars from me

reviews.t: Great concept but product did not really do much
reviews.x: I loved the idea of the socks, they are easy to apply and stay on. I used while watching tv and did not have a mess at all. But the product inside was not that strong. I did not feel a difference. I would suggest finding the same design but with a different product inside
It doesn't work like they described it. putting regular hand cream on my feel does a better job. Waste of money.
Very odd feeling at first, did 2 in 2 days, help get alot of the built up callous off.

reviews.t: A Great Value & Does The Trick
reviews.x: I use them monthly and they are a treat for my feet. Soothing and hydrating. Definitely worth it.

reviews.t: Decent results, but not what I was looking for
reviews.x: It came up as I was looking for a "foot peel mask" but this is not a peel mask, which I only realized when I already had the booties on. Not sure how I got to it and many people before me made the same mistake, as can be read in the reviews. The interior of the packaging was wet with the moisturizer that should be locked inside the booties. Besides, a manufacturing glitch glued the booties to the interior of the packaging and it gave me a hard time releasing them without causing any damage. I ke

To be honest I had used something similar before and left on for 2 hours and didn’t think it was enough time, so this time before bed I put them on over night.  It took about 3 days to start peeling but than it was hard to get ALL the peeling off.  Went about a week of attempting to remove the product. So my bad that I left on way more than 20 minutes, but my feet do look and feel better.  Just follow directions.
I love how soft this makes my rough feet.  I just slip them on while watching tv and in a little while my feet are soft and smooth.  I can usually get 3 to 4 uses out of a pair.
Really easy to use and relaxing, my feet felt immediately moisturized

reviews.t: I don't know why these work
reviews.x: I don't know why these work so well but they do! It's hard to find them in stores, they sell out fast, because they work! It's really the only thing that works for me. I don't know which ingredient it is - I thought it was the macademia oil itself but I bought some when I couldn't find these in stores and it didn't work like these masks do. Great product! Bit expensive but if it works, it works

I bought these so I could get a good start on repairing my Frankenfeet yes that's right Frankenfeet lol. And I think it works pretty good left my feet moisturized for a bit to give me a good start on getting healthy feet. I will continue to use for awhile. Now I'm gonna say this. This product is NOT i repeat NOT a foot peel mask. It's just ment to moisturize your feet. Also do NOT WALK I'm them you will slip it even says it on the back if you need to walk aroungThe little stap things didn't work

I received a sample of these a few months ago.  Forgot about it until the other day.  Don't walk in these. Your foot slips around in the bootie.  Put them on where you plan on being for 20 min.  I think if I used them regularly, perhaps I would have given 5 stars.  As I only received one pair, I have to judge based on one use.  Wasn'tt crazy about the texture; took a bit to get used to.  Slippery, sort of slimy.  My feet did feel nice and soft.  I am going to purchase a multi pack and see if reg

I LOVE Amope products, but this time it failed me. This product is well packaged, easy to use, and mess free. I previously bought these peels as Christmas gifts for friends. I then bought this for myself, it has been 2 weeks and I have not peeled. 2 friends reported their feet never peeled either. I’m disappointed. I will try again. Fingers crossed.

reviews.t: Put on Netflix and forget them. They were worth it.
reviews.x: It feels like your foot is in a grocery bag with lotion in it so kind of uncomfortable.  It did leave my feet VERY soft (and most days I walk bare foot).  It's not pretty but it helps. What I did was sit the packet in hot water before opening and it was comfortable. My feet did not peel at all. I would buy again.

i wanted my feet back to soft and with lockdown in IL i cant go to the spa. but i didnt want my feet to peel. or be chemically treated like other foot masks. the amope feet masks transformed my heels from being hard and cracked. and even more so after a few days with only 1 treatment.

reviews.t: They make your feet soft for like an hour
reviews.x: You pretty much have to keep it on for 20 minutes so your feet stay soft for an hour.... redundant. One of mine was leaking out when I received it. I would not recommend this product.
This product dies not give the results that it claims! Do not purchase this product! I have used these types of foot masks from Ulta that did an amazing job. This mask did NOTHING!
These make my feet so soft! I wish the softness would last longer. But my feet feel great for about 3 days after using! Great excuse to sit with your feet up for about a half hour!
My daughter and used this product it was pleasant to use but did not do anything like there advertised to do ( like peeling off the old skin ) I was very disappointed .
Tried more than once and it didn't do any good for my feet. Guess if you live in a place where you wear sandles most of the year this won't work.

reviews.t: Its not working like they described
reviews.x: Its not working like they described , i used 3 already following them directions and no resualts
Easy to use.  Cheapest price anywhere. Very effective and easy to use.
It really does leave your feet so soft. I would defiantly buy again.😃
My feet are so soft! Love the way the foot wrap feels on my feet!!
My feet were in very bad shape and this product helped a lot!

claims.text: Many reviewers say the product leaves feet soft, smooth, and moisturized, often after just one use.
Several reviewers find the product easy to use and mess-free, often wearing them while watching TV.
Some reviewers report the product did not work for them or did not deliver the peeling results they expected.
A few reviewers note the booties feel odd or uncomfortable, and one warns against walking in them.
Some reviewers mention good value, getting multiple uses out of a pair or using them regularly.
